Meeting.title: Meeting
Meeting.description: A scheduled meeting reservation for one of the three office meeting rooms.

title.description: Short title or subject of the meeting.

organizer.description: Person or team responsible for the meeting (no personal contact PII).

startMinutes.description: Start time in minutes from midnight (420 to 1110, step 30).

endMinutes.description: End time in minutes from midnight (450 to 1140, step 30).

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the meeting.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the meeting was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the meeting was last updated.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Authorized administrator role record keyed by user UID.

/meetings/{meetingId}.description: Publicly readable meeting reservations for Sala piso 8 DAP, Sala A OPT, and Sala B OPT; writable exclusively by verified administrators.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Administrator allowlist keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
